project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test whether the nonstationarity exposed by R3E can be handled by requiring agreement between independently fitted fast and slow causal recency windows, without using 2025 or 2026 and without altering Teacher V2 or Student-250.

predecessor.allowed_learning_from_failure: R3E showed materially worse 2023 H2 behavior than H1 and no Q passed. R3F changes the architecture prospectively to recency-consensus; it does not retune an R3E threshold.

targets.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after signal timestamp

monthly_training.fit_frequency: once per evaluation month using dates strictly before that month

model_family_per_window_per_horizon.event_threshold: unweighted 75th percentile of abs(y_h) inside that window only

score_definition.window_raw_side_score: sign*mu + T_h*sign*(P_up-P_down), sign=+1 CE and -1 PE
score_definition.window_percentile: empirical percentile of evaluation raw side score against raw side scores on that same window's training rows
score_definition.eligibility: fast raw side score > 0 AND slow raw side score > 0

calibration.selection_rule: Among Q values passing every gate, choose highest worst-half net3 mean, then highest overall net3 mean, then highest net5 mean, then stricter Q.
calibration.if_none_pass: Retire R3F and do not open 2024 for R3F. Preregister a distinct R3G before any R3G model output.

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
